items.title: Young lawyer seeks court ruling to end NBTC crisis
items.body: A 26-year-old lawyer has filed a petition with the Central Administrative Court, seeking a ruling to remove Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck as chairman of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC).

items.title: FDA Classifies Egg Recall as Class I for Highest Health Risk
items.body: Nearly 20 million eggs were recalled in July over salmonella concerns. The new classification signals a “reasonable probability” of “serious adverse health consequences or death.”

items.title: New B450 tourism fee expected to be collected from April 2027
items.body: Thailand is likely to start collecting the tourism fee from foreign travellers at the revised rate of 450 baht as early as next April, according to the Tourism and Sports Ministry.

items.title: Lawsuit Accuses Selena Gomez of Defrauding Investors in Mental Health Site
